_comment: Mock-only fixture for GET /admin/reviews. `created_hours_ago` becomes `created_at` so the list reads as recent whenever the app is run; it is removed before responding. A null user is a deleted account.

items.body: This is the first internship tool that tells me WHY something matched. The reason chips are the whole thing for me.

Love the timeline. Ghosted as a real state made me laugh and then made me feel better.

Wish I could export my applications to a spreadsheet for my career advisor.
The feed kept showing me hardware roles even though I only ranked software and data. Maybe I set something wrong?
Found two security internships I had never seen on any other list. Applied to both the same night.
Useful, but the dashboard is a lot on my phone. Filters in a sheet is good, the cards are long.
Signed up and got an empty feed. Turned out my graduation year was wrong. An error would have helped.
Would be great if it reminded me to follow up after a week of silence. Otherwise solid.
Clean, fast, no ads. Please never add ads.
Resume upload pulled out Python and SQL but missed Tableau and R.
Sort by newest first is exactly what I needed during the September rush.
I applied through the card but the posting link was dead. Not StEP1's fault probably but annoying.

Told my whole Info Sci section about it.
Thanks for building this.
